briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China AGI race while safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record funding. US export controls tighten as Chinese labs close capability gaps. Prompt injection attacks surge in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic Claude 4 and Google Gemini 3.5 traded benchmark leads this week. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant while xAI deployed Grok-3 internally.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime monitoring.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began 2nm AI chip production for Microsoft and Google. Saudi Arabia announced $40B AI data center cluster. NVIDIA H200 supply constraints persist into Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent architectures outpace current safety frameworks by 2027?
